description: This file defines a marker interface Customizable for classes that can have custom attributes added to them, enabling user customization within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: Customizable
classes.description: A generic interface for objects that support adding and retrieving custom attributes of type A.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns all attributes associated with the object, including those that are voided.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Returns non-voided attributes of a specific type.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds a new attribute to the object.
